title: Indivisible capacity request review
description: review_requests(request) validates the whole request before assessing alternatives, raising ValueError for invalid input (message unspecified) without mutation. Each lot is indivisible and can be used at most once within a request. Only unheld lots at listed sites are eligible. Requests are independent what-if assessments: do not reserve or consume lots between requests. For each request return exactly whether some selection totals the target, not whether available units merely exceed it; zero target permits the empty selection. Return lot_count, requests and possible_request_ids. Each request report contains request_id, target, eligible_lot_ids in lot input order, available_units (sum over all eligible lots), and exact_capacity_exists (bool). Request reports and the possible-ID summary retain request order. No witness, allocation or count of solutions is required. Empty site lists and unknown sites are allowed and contribute no lots. Empty lots/requests are supported. The CLI reads one JSON request and prints one JSON report; invalid input has nonzero exit and no successful report.
